name: COUNT
description: Returns the number of rows, or the number of rows for which expression evaluates to a value other than NULL.

name: COUNTIF
description: Returns the count of TRUE values for the given boolean expression. Returns 0 when there are zero input rows.

name: SUM
description: Returns the sum of non-NULL values. Returns NULL when the input contains only NULL values.

name: AVG
description: Returns the average of non-NULL values. Produces NaN when the input contains a NaN value.

name: MIN
description: Returns the minimum non-NULL value of the input expression.

name: MAX
description: Returns the maximum non-NULL value of the input expression.

name: ARRAY_AGG
signatures: ARRAY_AGG([DISTINCT] expression [IGNORE NULLS] [ORDER BY key] [LIMIT n])
description: Returns an ARRAY of the expression values. The element order is non-deterministic unless ORDER BY is specified.

name: STRING_AGG
signatures: STRING_AGG([DISTINCT] expression [, delimiter] [ORDER BY key] [LIMIT n])
description: Concatenates non-NULL STRING or BYTES values, separated by the delimiter, which defaults to a comma.

name: ANY_VALUE
description: Returns an arbitrary non-NULL value from the input. Which value is returned is non-deterministic.

name: LOGICAL_AND
description: Returns TRUE when every non-NULL input value is TRUE.

name: LOGICAL_OR
description: Returns TRUE when at least one non-NULL input value is TRUE.

name: APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT
description: Returns the approximate number of distinct non-NULL values. Faster and cheaper than COUNT(DISTINCT) on large inputs, at the cost of exactness.

name: APPROX_QUANTILES
description: Returns the approximate boundaries for a group of values, splitting the input into the requested number of quantiles.

name: ARRAY_LENGTH
description: Returns the size of the array. Returns 0 for an empty array and NULL when the array is NULL.

name: CURRENT_DATE
description: Returns the current date. Defaults to the UTC time zone when no time zone is given.

name: CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
description: Returns the current date and time as a TIMESTAMP, with microsecond precision.

name: CURRENT_DATETIME
description: Returns the current time as a DATETIME. Defaults to the UTC time zone when no time zone is given.

name: DATE
description: Constructs or extracts a DATE value from its arguments.

name: DATETIME
signatures: DATETIME(year, month, day, hour, minute, second)
description: Constructs a DATETIME value from its arguments.

name: TIMESTAMP
description: Converts a string, date, or datetime expression into a TIMESTAMP.

name: DATE_ADD
description: Adds a specified time interval to a DATE. Supported date parts are DAY, WEEK, MONTH, QUARTER and YEAR.

name: DATE_SUB
description: Subtracts a specified time interval from a DATE. Supported date parts are DAY, WEEK, MONTH, QUARTER and YEAR.

name: DATE_DIFF
description: Returns the whole number of date_part intervals between two DATE values, computed as the first date minus the second.

name: DATE_TRUNC
description: Truncates a DATE to the granularity of date_part. The returned value is the earliest date within the specified granularity.

name: FORMAT_DATE
description: Formats a DATE according to the given format string, for example '%Y-%m-%d'.

name: PARSE_DATE
description: Converts a string representation of a date into a DATE, using the given format string.

name: TIMESTAMP_ADD
description: Adds a time interval to a TIMESTAMP. Supported date parts range from MICROSECOND to DAY.

name: TIMESTAMP_SUB
description: Subtracts a time interval from a TIMESTAMP. Supported date parts range from MICROSECOND to DAY.

name: TIMESTAMP_DIFF
description: Returns the whole number of date_part intervals between two TIMESTAMP values.

name: TIMESTAMP_TRUNC
description: Truncates a TIMESTAMP to the granularity of date_part.

name: DATETIME_TRUNC
description: Truncates a DATETIME to the granularity of date_part.

name: DATETIME_DIFF
description: Returns the whole number of date_part intervals between two DATETIME values.

name: FORMAT_TIMESTAMP
description: Formats a TIMESTAMP according to the given format string.

name: PARSE_TIMESTAMP
description: Converts a string representation of a timestamp into a TIMESTAMP, using the given format string.

name: EXTRACT
signatures: EXTRACT(part FROM timestamp_expression [AT TIME ZONE time_zone])
description: Returns a single part of a date or timestamp value, such as YEAR, MONTH, DAY, HOUR, DAYOFWEEK or ISOWEEK.
returns: INT64, DATE or TIME depending on the part

name: UNIX_SECONDS
description: Returns the number of seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC, truncating any sub-second precision.

name: UNIX_MILLIS
description: Returns the number of milliseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.

name: TIMESTAMP_SECONDS
description: Interprets an integer as the number of seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC and returns a TIMESTAMP.

name: TIMESTAMP_MILLIS
description: Interprets an integer as the number of milliseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC and returns a TIMESTAMP.

name: LAST_DAY
description: Returns the last day of the period containing the given date. The date part defaults to MONTH.

name: DATE_FROM_UNIX_DATE
description: Interprets an integer as the number of days since 1970-01-01 and returns a DATE.

name: GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY
description: Returns an array of dates spanning the inclusive range, stepping by the given interval.

name: CONCAT
description: Concatenates its arguments into a single value. Returns NULL when any argument is NULL.

name: SUBSTR
description: Returns a substring starting at the one-based position. A negative position counts back from the end of the value.

name: LENGTH
description: Returns the length of the value in characters for STRING, or in bytes for BYTES.

name: LOWER
description: Returns the value with all alphabetic characters converted to lowercase.

name: UPPER
description: Returns the value with all alphabetic characters converted to uppercase.

name: TRIM
description: Removes leading and trailing characters from the value. Removes whitespace when no character set is given.

name: LTRIM
description: Removes leading characters from the value. Removes whitespace when no character set is given.

name: RTRIM
description: Removes trailing characters from the value. Removes whitespace when no character set is given.

name: REPLACE
description: Replaces every occurrence of from_pattern with to_value. Returns the original value when from_pattern is empty.

name: SPLIT
description: Splits the value using the delimiter and returns an array. The delimiter defaults to a comma for STRING input.

name: STARTS_WITH
description: Returns TRUE when the value begins with the given prefix.

name: ENDS_WITH
description: Returns TRUE when the value ends with the given suffix.

name: CONTAINS_SUBSTR
description: Performs a normalized, case-insensitive search for the value anywhere in the expression, including inside STRUCT and ARRAY fields.

name: REGEXP_CONTAINS
description: Returns TRUE when the value contains a partial match for the RE2 regular expression.

name: REGEXP_EXTRACT
description: Returns the first substring matching the regular expression, or the first capturing group when the expression has one.

name: REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL
description: Returns an array of all non-overlapping substrings matching the regular expression.

name: REGEXP_REPLACE
description: Replaces all substrings matching the regular expression. Backslash-escaped digits in the replacement refer to capturing groups.

name: LPAD
description: Prepends the pattern to the value until it reaches the requested length. The pattern defaults to a space.

name: RPAD
description: Appends the pattern to the value until it reaches the requested length. The pattern defaults to a space.

name: REVERSE
description: Returns the reverse of the input STRING or BYTES value.

name: FORMAT
description: Formats a string using printf-style format specifiers such as %s, %d and %t.

name: LEFT
description: Returns the leftmost characters or bytes of the value.

name: RIGHT
description: Returns the rightmost characters or bytes of the value.

name: NORMALIZE
description: Normalizes a string using the given Unicode normalization mode, which defaults to NFC.

name: REPEAT
description: Returns the value repeated the given number of times.

name: STRPOS
description: Returns the one-based position of the first occurrence of subvalue, or 0 when it is not found.

name: TO_JSON_STRING
description: Returns a JSON-formatted string representation of the value.

name: CAST
description: Converts the expression to the target type. Raises an error when the conversion fails.

name: SAFE_CAST
description: Converts the expression to the target type, returning NULL instead of raising an error when the conversion fails.

name: IFNULL
description: Returns null_result when expr is NULL, otherwise returns expr. Both arguments must be of the same type.

name: NULLIF
description: Returns NULL when the two expressions are equal, otherwise returns the first expression.

name: COALESCE
description: Returns the value of the first non-NULL expression. The remaining expressions are not evaluated.

name: IF
description: Returns true_result when expr evaluates to TRUE, otherwise returns else_result. Only one branch is evaluated.

name: PARSE_JSON
description: Converts a JSON-formatted string into a JSON value.

name: JSON_VALUE
description: Extracts a scalar value from JSON and returns it as a SQL STRING. Returns NULL when the selected value is not scalar.

name: JSON_QUERY
description: Extracts a JSON value, such as an array or object, and returns it as a JSON-formatted string.

name: JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR
description: Legacy alias for extracting a scalar value from JSON. Prefer JSON_VALUE in new code.

name: GENERATE_UUID
description: Returns a random universally unique identifier as a lowercase 36-character string.

name: FARM_FINGERPRINT
description: Computes the fingerprint of the value using the FarmHash Fingerprint64 function. Useful for deterministic bucketing.

name: TO_HEX
description: Converts a BYTES value into a hexadecimal STRING.

name: MD5
description: Computes the MD5 hash of the input and returns it as BYTES. Not suitable for security purposes.

name: SHA256
description: Computes the SHA-256 hash of the input and returns it as BYTES.

name: ROW_NUMBER
description: Returns the sequential one-based row number within each window partition. No ties are produced.

name: RANK
description: Returns the rank of each row within the window partition. Tied rows share a rank and leave gaps in the sequence.

name: DENSE_RANK
description: Returns the rank of each row within the window partition. Tied rows share a rank and leave no gaps.

name: LAG
description: Returns the value of the row that precedes the current row by the given offset, which defaults to 1.

name: LEAD
description: Returns the value of the row that follows the current row by the given offset, which defaults to 1.

name: FIRST_VALUE
description: Returns the value of value_expression for the first row in the current window frame.

name: LAST_VALUE
description: Returns the value of value_expression for the last row in the current window frame.

name: NTH_VALUE
description: Returns the value of value_expression at the given one-based position of the current window frame.

name: NTILE
description: Divides the window partition into the given number of buckets and returns the one-based bucket number of each row.

name: PERCENT_RANK
description: Returns the percentile rank of each row, between 0 and 1 inclusive.

name: CUME_DIST
description: Returns the relative rank of each row, defined as the number of peers or preceding rows divided by the total row count.

name: PERCENTILE_CONT
description: Computes the specified percentile using linear interpolation between the surrounding input values.

name: ROUND
description: Rounds the value to the given number of decimal digits, which defaults to 0.

name: FLOOR
description: Returns the largest integral value that is not greater than the input.

name: CEIL
description: Returns the smallest integral value that is not less than the input.

name: ABS
description: Returns the absolute value of the input.

name: MOD
description: Returns the remainder of the division. Raises an error when the divisor is zero.

name: SAFE_DIVIDE
description: Divides x by y, returning NULL instead of raising an error when y is zero.

name: GREATEST
description: Returns the largest of the input values. Returns NULL when any argument is NULL.

name: LEAST
description: Returns the smallest of the input values. Returns NULL when any argument is NULL.

name: TRUNC
description: Truncates the value toward zero at the given number of decimal digits, which defaults to 0.
